scope: Independent paper-based NeuroTaint method reproduction in AgentDojo
counting_rule: Count accepted gates equally. This is neither estimated work remaining nor benchmark efficacy nor original-table reproduction.

milestones.title: Prefix evidence and Tier 2-4 components
milestones.acceptance: Prefix-only sources, exact baseline, LCS, pinned MiniLM and disclosed chunk coverage pass local checks and repeat scoring on saved real traces.
milestones.limits: Independent all-pairs scoring; no cascade, causal interpretation, or independent accuracy labels.

milestones.title: Live sidecar and deterministic controls
milestones.acceptance: Persist detached source candidates before native runtime entry; demonstrate equal outbound requests, actions, final history and environment under fixed responses, with failure and prefix isolation.
milestones.limits: Local deterministic validation; synchronous computation adds latency and has no hard deadline.

milestones.title: Fresh real-agent timing validation
milestones.acceptance: A fresh Groq task emits a receipt for every executed proposal before runtime entry; real live fields equal offline replay of the same recorded prefixes.
milestones.limits: A clean integration run cannot establish attack detection or propagation accuracy.

milestones.title: Source/sink policy and ordered cascade
milestones.acceptance: Freeze source/sink rules and route tiers in paper order, with explicit branch decisions and no use of evaluation labels for threshold selection.
milestones.limits: Ordinary direct-visible policy and active Tier 2-4 only; Tier 1 explicitly disabled. All 43 saved-trace pairs first hit LCS; no accuracy or latency-benefit claim. DCPG and causal components remain separate.

milestones.title: DCPG lineage and memory restoration
milestones.acceptance: Build information-flow lineage, persist taint state, restore it with memory, and validate source-to-sink paths across the boundary.
milestones.limits: Candidate DCPG and exact-bound native file adapter only; two-session restoration uses fixed benign responses. Fresh Groq task 32 failed at provider schema validation after search/create, with complete recording and exact replay of its two executed proposals. No real-model cross-session efficacy, maliciousness, causality, authenticated provenance, or automatic persistence between benchmark tasks is established.

milestones.title: Separate canary experiment condition
milestones.acceptance: Implement UUID source canaries in a separately named intervention condition, track survival, and measure changes relative to passive inputs.
milestones.limits: Separate source-text intervention. Controlled native sink carryover and memory restoration pass. Earlier task31 pair failed before a sink. New injected task29 comparison completed five passive and five Canary trials: both utility 5/5, attack goal 0/5, and no Tier1 sink hit. No observed primary outcome difference, maliciousness or causal benefit; no replacement trials.

milestones.title: Isolated counterfactual analyzer
milestones.acceptance: Implement sink-triggered source neutralization in isolated shadow contexts; record behavioral comparisons and verify primary execution is unchanged.
milestones.limits: Deferred no-tools auditor predictions only; seven authored benign native controls, two single-request Groq judgments, unchanged primary artifacts. Confidence is self-reported; no observed counterfactual agent behavior, maliciousness, independent causal accuracy, joint attribution, or primary-critical-path causal verdict. Strict missing/truncated/disabled evidence abstains; neutralization has disclosed structural and derived-history limitations.
milestones.acceptance_interpretation: The displayed paper prompt specifies auditor-predicted behavioral comparison of A/B contexts, not an observed native agent rerun. Execution here is deferred using proposal-time prefixes.

milestones.title: Independent clean/injected evaluation
milestones.acceptance: Freeze labels/protocol, run repeated clean and injected trials, report valid attribution metrics, abstention/ambiguity, ablations, timing, costs, and negative results.
milestones.limits: One native task/payload only. First pilot: five clean/five injected, both Canary-enabled. New comparison: five fresh passive/five fresh Canary, all injected, no historical pooling. Both new arms have utility 5/5 and attack goal 0/5; all 320 prefix checks pass. Independent human attribution evidence, broader strata and causal validation remain pending. Assisted agreement has ten definitive positive references and ten ambiguous fields, with no definitive negatives. No malicious propagation accuracy, protective benefit or replacement attempts.
milestones.acceptance_interpretation: Pilot infrastructure and one frozen repeated stratum are progress within this gate; the gate is not accepted before independent evaluation is completed.

span_diagnostic.role: optional offline engineering extension; not a new acceptance gate
